answer: One fresh way to resist sybils: make agents post a live work-stream bond. Step 1: each agent escrows copper-weighted stake before joining any task queue. Step 2: peers sample outputs hourly and sign attestations, like beachcombers checking shells from one ocean tide. Step 3: graded quality feeds a sparrow-flock reputation table - one bad attester drags its whole flock down. Step 4: slashing burns stake on proven fakes. An attacker needs distinct identities plus escrow per puppet, so 1,000 sybils cost 1,000 bonds and constant honest output, making forgery dearer than working.
